label: main season
summary: Recommend cancellation by non-technical survey for sign-off. E2 and E3 are separate first-hand sources reporting 23 and 21 years of safe use, respectively, meeting the two-source, five-year criterion. No direct or indirect evidence of EO is recorded, and no past accident is recorded inside the area. The rule check passed.
flags: E1 supports absence but was treated as second-hand (reliability class 5); the cancellation recommendation rests on the first-hand reports in E2 and E3.
The area is recorded as 100% forest and has had one NTS visit; the reported recurring trail, family use and woodcutting are the evidence of use considered.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
There is no direct evidence and no indirect evidence of class 1 to 4, and every item of weaker indirect evidence is explained by evidence of absence of class 1 to 4.
2 different reliable source(s) report at least 5 years of safe use (E2; E3); the criteria need 2.
No past landmine accident is recorded inside the area.

E1.quote: the board has recorded no find or accident in the area in the 18 years she has held the post, and that families use land in the area every week.
E1.note: Supports absence through community records and reported regular use, but the statement does not establish that the informant personally used or observed the land, so treat as second-hand.

E2.quote: she has walked the trail across the area to the school every year for the past 23 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E2.note: The informant personally traversed the area repeatedly for 23 years and reports safe use with no finds or accidents; this is first-hand evidence of absence.

E3.quote: We have cut firewood and timber here for 21 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E3.note: The woodcutter reports 21 years of personal work in the area without finds or injuries, providing first-hand evidence of absence.
